integrity: All proofs and finite certificates are original calculations. Numerical comparisons corroborate but do not replace infinite-degree proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree only, no nonuniform sampling, no bandlimited reconstruction; the sharp inverse constant uses the specified probability-surface and dimension normalization. The 1965 cubic lattice harmonic tables were not inspected beyond the publisher abstract, so historical priority is qualified.
title: Sharp all-degree harmonic interpolation on the regular cuboctahedron
